validation.ack_observability: Patch 0010 preserves opt-in ACK-state observability. In the historical zero-stagger five-instance diagnostic, the first Reset Complete response-to-HLI timestamp delta was 4.506306s of host trace time, not guest virtual time; at the first ACK check ack=NULL and semaphore count 0.
validation.concurrency_validation: Two independent two-instance no-stagger 4x120s gates pass 8/8, two independent three-instance 3x120s gates pass 6/6, and two independent four-instance 4x120s gates pass 8/8. Patch 0008 preallocates real guest HCI-event buffers and ACL mbufs while CPU0 is idle; patch 0009 expands the real reserve to 8 event/4 ACL objects. Every passing historical lease records 36 events/9 ACLs on the fast path, HLI 45/45 and hli-errors=0. Two independent five-instance 5x120s batches pass 10/10 and two zero-stagger six-instance gates pass 12/12. The earlier shift=auto zero-stagger five-instance cold start produced one batch passed 5/5 and an independent confirmation failed 3/5. After calibrating the sustained floor to hold/12, two independent eight-instance 8x120s gates pass 16/16 total at the service per-device cap of 8. Under the current QEMU/runtime, two independent zero-stagger 2x60s controls pass 4/4 using a three-sweep hold/40 floor and bounded HTTP/public recheck retries; PSRAM and recoverable network errors have separate evidence fields. Three independent zero-stagger 9x120s attempts produced 9/9, 9/9 and 8/9. The failure was observed at real concurrency 9 and panicked in ble_hs_hci_process_ack at PC 0x402630cc; the following 0x40092e43 panic occurred during reboot. Nine-instance capacity is rejected, DEFAULT_MAX_PER_DEVICE and runner concurrency remain 8, and concurrency 9 is fail-closed. A current-load zero-stagger eight-instance cold-start rebind remains open because host contention prevented all leases from completing guest BLE initialization. The reconnect contract remains 1-121 with 122 rejected. Sustained throughput and teardown modes beyond active-stop also remain OPEN.
validation.memory_validation: The m5core2 machine now exposes a QOM-effective 8 MiB PSRAM device. Normal ESP32 DRAM1 remains a 4 MiB directly mapped heap window; a dedicated ESP-IDF esp_himem probe passed in three independent Device Service leases, mapping two different 32 KiB physical blocks through the same virtual MMU window and verifying both after remap (4,456,448 bytes himem capacity, 262,144-byte reserve). Guest sustained stress remains PASS in three independent 120-second leases (35/35/35 checks, 105 MiB total) and one 600-second lease (179 checks). Physical PSRAM/cache timing remains NOT RUN.
validation.detail: 官方 UIFlow2 v2.5.3 在同一 m5core2 guest 内通过 320x240 显示/触摸、AXP2101、INA3221、MPU6886、PCF8563、NS4168 扬声器、SPM1423 麦克风、OpenMAC WiFi DHCP/HTTP、example.com IPv4 DNS/HTTP 和 stock firmware 外部 BLE GATT。规范 Device Service profile `core2-native-hci` 已通过 HCI-4、121 轮重连、active-BLE 长稳、active-stop、bounded TCG 和八实例并发。最终 `tb-size=128` 两小时复测绑定 firmware/ELF/QEMU/工具哈希，RSS 323536→252992 KiB、phys footprint 250880→188416 KiB；两批六实例为 12/12，历史八实例合计 16/16。m5core2 machine 现以 8 MiB PSRAM device 和 DRAM1 32 KiB MMU 页映射运行；三个独立 esp_himem lease、三个 120 秒 guest PSRAM 压力和一次 600 秒联网压力均 PASS。当前工具哈希下两批独立 `2x60s` 为 `4/4 PASS`，每 lease 完成三次 PSRAM sweep、两次 controlled/公网重检、WiFi、GATT、frame/QOM、pcap 和 cleanup。三次九实例尝试为 9/9、9/9、8/9；失败在真实并发 9 时触发 `ble_hs_hci_process_ack` `0x402630cc` panic，因此九实例被拒绝，默认容量保持 8。legacy UIFlow 的 shared I2C、equal-deadline timer、TIMG WDT level、QIO/stateful SSI、统一 handoff timeline、exact-time pause/state sweep、setter trace、WDT liveness 和 WDT-off late-state 对照均已形成可重放证据。0064 修复 pending SPI source 在 interrupt-matrix remap 后不投递的通用缺陷；0095 修复 legacy task-WDT level delivery，同一 public firmware 三次 normal-WDT Device Service 运行均越过原 15.55 秒 stage-1 reset，保持 API Key startup UI 到 guest virtual 300 秒以上。setup/REPL 独立交互、完整 factory application、当前宿主负载下的八实例 cold-start 重绑、物理 cache/PSRAM、持续吞吐、其他 teardown 模式与 Espressif BT baseband/controller bit-exact 执行仍未完成。

validation.detail: 自建 bare-metal 探针（tests/uiflow2/stickt2_probe，xtensa-esp-elf 14.2.0 编译，ELF SHA-256 记录在证据中）由 QEMU -kernel 加载到新 machine `m5stickt2`，经真实内存映射控制器完成：UART0 标记输出；GPIO bit-bang I2C 上的 FLIR Lepton CCI （PING/序列号/FPA+AUX 温度/OEM sync 设置，16-bit CCI 寄存器）；HSPI 上的 VoSPI 流（164 字节包、4 段×60 包/frame，CRC 字段本固件不校验）解出 160×120 热帧，连续 3 帧的 guest FNV-1a digest 与宿主按模型 fixture seed 0/1/2 独立重建完全一致、0 包错误；ST7789 135×240 面板经 VSPI 初始化并渲染热帧，QMP 截图 135×240、32,400 非黑像素、89 种颜色；QOM 注入 encoder increment=5 被 guest 读回。另：官方 M5Burner `StickT2 User Demo` v1.0 4 MB 镜像在确定性 icount 下经 classic UART TX_DONE latch 修复后可启动到 `M5StickC initializing...OK`，但其热成像/UI 路径未在运行窗口内到达且不可注入探针，因此不作为数据面证据。物理 LWIR 光学/热测量、Grove、PDM 麦克风、编码器实际接线（文档 PA2/PA3/PA4 与官方示例 I2C 0x30 的矛盾按官方示例取 I2C 0x30）与完整工厂 UI 未验证。

blockers: Thermal virtual-device data plane passed with the committed bare-metal probe: Lepton CCI commands/PID-free register path, deterministic VoSPI frames matching the host fixture oracle, ST7789 panel screenshot and encoder QOM injection.
